title: World Cup in Business Central: predictions and results ⚽🥅
summary: A World Cup prediction extension for Business Central that lets users share forecasts, track matches imported from a JSON source, register predictions, and compete on a leaderboard with automatic scoring based on exact scores or correct outcomes.
key_points: Extension imports World Cup matches from public JSON sources and displays date, time, round, group, teams, stadium, and results
Users enter predictions for each match and earn points automatically: 3 for exact score, 1 for correct outcome
Leaderboard ranks users by total points and tracks exact hits and correct outcomes across all predictions
Role Center widget visualizes World Cup matches and results; setup page configures the external data source URL
Solution includes tables for matches and predictions, pages for calendar and forecasts, codeunits for import and scoring logic, and control add-in for visual display

quotes.text: The extension setup allows the source URL to be configured.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows how the solution provides flexibility for connecting to different external data sources

quotes.text: The scoring logic is simple: 3 points for an exact score prediction. 1 point for predicting the correct match outcome.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core gamification mechanism that motivates user engagement

quotes.text: The leaderboard brings all predictions together into a general ranking that makes it easy to see who is leading.
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes how the extension creates social competition and user engagement through visible rankings
